articles.title: Anthony Clark, “Yes, Dear” and “Boston Common” star, dies at 62
articles.summary: Friend and castmate Mike O’Malley remembered him as a “hilarious guy” and “so unique.”
articles.body:
Anthony Clark, the actor and comedian known for his starring role on the sitcom Yes, Dear , has died at 62.

His death was announced by friend and Yes, Dear castmate Mike O'Malley, who remembered him as "so unique" and "a hilarious guy."

Clark also featured in comedy specials with Dave Chappelle and Gary Shandling.

Anthony Clark, the actor and comedian known for starring on the sitcoms Yes, Dear and Boston Common , died Tuesday at 62.

His friend and Yes, Dear castmate Mike O'Malley announced the news on social media , sharing a heartfelt tribute. "He was a hilarious guy," O'Malley wrote. "When my wife Lisa and I were dating back in the mid-nineties, Anthony was already famous in Boston, regularly selling out comedy shows. The first time we saw him at The Comedy Connection we laughed and laughed and laughed."

He added that Clark was "so unique — one of those comics who is laughing along with you at the absurdity of his stories and observations and it just made you laugh harder because he was laughing. I was a fan before I was a friend."

In a comment on O'Malley's Instagram post, fellow comedian Dane Cook wrote of Clark, "He was one of the best live acts I've ever seen. Destroyed to a point he made you wanna quit right then and there while watching him do it effortlessly. This is really terrible to hear."

Born in Lynchburg, Va., Clark graduated from Emerson College and got his showbiz start as a stand-up comic.

Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter .

Breaking into television, he starred on the short-lived sitcoms Boston Common , playing a campus handyman, and Soul Man , playing an assistant minister opposite Dan Aykroyd.

Clark found more lasting success on the CBS comedy Yes, Dear , which ran for six seasons, from 2000 to 2006. He played Greg Warner, an uptight studio executive raising the perfect nuclear family alongside his wife, Kim (Jean Louisa Kelly). The sudden arrival of her free-spirited sister, Christine (Liza Snyer), and Christine's laid-back, working-class, husband Jimmy (O'Malley), throws their life into delightful disarray.

Clark also worked on the big screen, making his film debut in Nancy Savoca's beloved coming-of-age drama Dogfight in 1991. He followed that appearance with a role in Peter Bogdanovich's The Thing Called Love , which featured River Phoenix and Sandra Bullock.

Back on the small screen, Clark appeared on series like Ellen , Sesame Street , and Last Comic Standing , which he hosted in season 4.

Manager Barry Katz eulogized Clark as "one of the funniest people that I have ever met in my lifetime." In a touching Instagram post , Katz also remembered Clark as "one of the most talented actors" he'd worked with, accompanying the tribute with a photo of Clark with Chappelle, Cook, and Elon Gold.

articles.title: Mormon Wives ' Aspyn Ovard Shares Daughter's Terminal Cancer Diagnosis
articles.summary: Aspyn Ovard shared during the premiere episode of Hulu's Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County that her and ex-husband Parker Ferris' daughter was diag...
articles.body:
Aspyn Ovard 's family is navigating an unimaginable health journey.

The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County star, mom to daughters Cove , 7, Lola , 5, and Elle , 2, with ex-husband Parker Ferris , shared that one of their kids has been diagnosed with terminal cancer.

"Everything happened so, just out of nowhere," Ovard said through tears during a confessional interview for the Hulu show, which premiered Nov. 12. "One day she was OK, and then the next day she wasn't."

"At the hospital, you're like, 'It has to be fine,'" the 30-year-old continued. "You can't fathom that they're actually going to tell you that your baby has cancer, and that it's terminal. She could be gone in a month, we don't know. I've been living like that for over three years, just having no idea."

As Ovard explained, her relationship with Ferris had already reached a breaking point prior to receiving the devastating health news.

"My marriage was nowhere near in a place to be able to make it through something like this," the YouTuber, who split from Ferris in 2024, noted. "We weren't even going to make it through before this happened."

"It was just so toxic and hard," she added. "And through all of it, I feel like I still tried to take care of him because I know how hard he's grieving."

During a therapy session with Ferris, Ovard— now part of a throuple with Bri Davis and her husband Billy Davis —explained to her ex that she's trying to make money so that they won't have to work if they're mourning the loss of a child.

"You know that I will always take care of you because I always have!" Ovard told Ferris during a disagreement. "When everything goes to s--t and things get really hard, I don't want you to have to do anything."

The former couple, high school sweethearts from Utah, tied the knot in October 2015 when she was 19 and he was 20.

Ovard filed for divorce from Ferris nearly nine years later , on April 1, 2024, the same day she announced the birth of their third daughter.

In September 2024, months after filing for divorce, Ovard revealed whether she'd ever consider walking down the aisle again .

"I don't think that I really believe in the concept of marriage at this point," she said on the Weekly Trash podcast at the time. "I would have a long-term partner if I met someone, and I feel like this is it. But to get legally married, I wouldn't ever do again. It's just too hard to separate."

"I think just legally, it's just too much to it," Ovard added. "Even the concept of marriage, you just never know what life is going to throw at you so I think to make those vows, I don't feel like I can really commit to that even if I loved someone so much."

"He styles me, that's how he supports me," she told E! News in May , adding that the basketball player, "picks out my outfits every day. He styles me every day for the show. It's great."
Aspyn Ovard , who filed for divorce from Parker Ferris in 2024 after eight years of marriage, is currently in a throuple relationship with married couple Billy Davis and Bri Davis .
After many ups and downs, Jen Affleck —who is pregnant with her and Zac Affleck 's fourth baby— officially filed for divorce from her husband of seven years , E! News confirmed Nov. 4.

Despite ongoing relationship speculation, Salomé Andrea and Aaron Brimhall are still going strong as they prepare to welcome their third baby together. The duo, who married in 2012, also share 8-year-old twins Luca and Rue .
McCall DaPron —the sister of Mormon Wives ' Mayci Neeley —shares four kids with husband Kirk DaPron , who she wed in 2011.

Ashleigh Pease and Nate Pease are rock solid after over a decade of marriage. "This 13th year together is one that has felt full circle!" she wrote on Instagram in September. "A season of fruits. Comfort. The happiest milestones."

Madison Bontempo and Kyler Steven Fisher , who wed in 2013, have been open about the highs and lows of their relationship. "Kyler and I aren't perfect," she wrote on Instagram in October. "We've had arguments. We've had hard seasons. We've had moments we wish we could take back. And we're not afraid to admit that." But, she added, "Those moments aren't our whole story. There's also laughter, friendship, forgiveness, growth, five beautiful children, a million memories, and a love that has continued to evolve through every season of our lives."

articles.title: Remembering Johnny Walker: Celebrating the legacy of beloved actor who brought joy to generations
articles.summary: A man emerges from the shadows on a foggy evening, oil bottles in hand and the promise of a cure-all head massage, singing \"Tel maalish, champi, tel
articles.body: A man emerges from the shadows on a foggy evening, oil bottles in hand and the promise of a cure-all head massage, singing "Tel maalish, champi, tel maalish"... Johnny Walker was the actor, Mohammed Rafi the voice crooning that ageless song and Guru Dutt the director.It has been almost 70 years since "Pyaasa", the film that spun cinema magic. And even in that elegiac classic, Johnny Walker stood out in his cameo as the amiable, empathetic Abdul Sattar - his brand of warmth and good humour standing the test of the decades.Born Badruddin Jamaluddin Kazi, Johnny Walker would have been 100 on Wednesday. The artist who redefined comedy and brought it out of the darkness into light with his exuberance, quite like the opening scene of his "Pyaasa" character.With his stylised acting, that particular tilt of the head and the distinctive voice, Johnny Walker was not one for histrionics or even great versatility. But his very presence in a film guaranteed a certain wholesomeness, sans double entendre or any other comedic device that became a staple of so many others who followed him.Be it Mehmood, Johnny Lever or Rajpal Yadav, later comedians owe a debt to Johnny Walker for giving comedy a respected space in Hindi cinema. The man -- who started life as a bus conductor and even sold vegetables before he became a marquee name -- walked so they could run.The comedian was also a man of interesting contrasts -- a teetotaller whose drunk acts were so convincing that he was rechristened after a popular whisky brand by none other than Guru Dutt, his mentor in cinema who ensured that the actor would get screen time and a song in almost all his films.Johnny Walker never drank or smoked in real life. Could not complete his school education so ensured his six children -- three sons and three daughters -- studied in the US.In many of Guru Dutt's films, Johnny Walker, distinctive with his pencil moustache, was both the comedic relief and the conscience keeper. His varied experiences and the poverty he witnessed in early youth enriched his portrayal of the everyday man on the street.But how did Badruddin, one of 12 children of a weaver who left Indore to Mumbai in search of a job, become the great comedian Johnny Walker?The most cited version involves actor-writer Balraj Sahni.Sahni had written the screenplay of the 1951 film "Baazi", which marked the debut of Guru Dutt. Around that time, he met a conductor on Mumbai's BEST buses and was completely charmed by the antics of the man.Impressed by his talent, Sahni advised the then Badruddin to visit the set of the film and perform his drunken act in front of Guru Dutt and lead star Dev Anand. He did as he was told and an impressed Guru Dutt ended up writing a character for him in the movie.It was the beginning of one of the most enduring friendships in Hindi cinema. Guru Dutt and Johnny Walker worked in almost every film, barring "Saheb Bibi Aur Ghulam".The director, who was famous for being a perfectionist, gave Johnny Walker the freedom to improvise his impromptu acts and also ensured that Rafi sang for him.In fact, Johnny Walker is said to be the artist with the third highest number of Rafi songs after Shammi Kapoor and Rajendra Kumar.Together, the two have numbers such as "Yeh Hai Bombay Meri Jaan" in "C.I.D.", "Suno Suno Miss Chatterjee" in "Baharein Phir Bhi Aayengi", "Jaane Kahan Mera Jigar Gaya Ji" from "Mr and Mrs 55" and "Hum Bhi Agar Bachche Hote" from "Door Ki Awaaz".In Dilip Kumar-starrer "Naya Daur", the ever-polite, hat-loving Johnny Walker makes an appearance as a press reporter from Mumbai and promises the villagers to make them famous. When asked to introduce himself, he sings the popular "Main Bambai ka babu, naam mera anjana.. English dhoon mein gaun main Hindustani gaana".Such was the popularity of his comedic performance and songs that producers ensured that almost always a song was picturised on Johnny Walker, a privilege accorded to few comedians in cinema.It was not always about songs though.In the 1971 hit "Anand", Johnny Walker played Issabhai Suratwal, a theatre actor who befriends Rajesh Khanna's character after a chance encounter. It's a brief appearance but one that stayed with audiences.Johnny Walker's real life love story was as dramatic as the plot of some of his films. While working on Guru Dutt's "Aar Paar", he fell in love with actor Shakila's sister Noorjahan. When Noorjahan's family opposed, the couple secretly got married.In cinema, whether he was playing a drunkard or a common man, Johnny Walker came to represent a decency and gentleness that was an extension of his real life personality.As cinema evolved, comedy too started undergoing a change. Black and white gave way to colour, and instead of laughs with grace came comedy edged with loudness and crassness.The roles disappeared and Johnny Walker chose to walk away from a career of 300 films.The glory years were the 1950s and 1960s. He was a popular name even in the 1970s. But the cinema of 1980s demanded a different kind of comedy, and Johnny Walker was unwilling to submit himself to double meaning dialogues and slapstick scenes.He bowed out with Kamal Haasan's "Chachi 420", his last film appearance in 1997 where he played an inebriated makeup artist.Johnny Walker died in 2003 at the age of 77, leaving an imprint of affectionate laughs that stays on in celluloid.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Las lluvias y el viento continuarán durante el fin de semana en España: zonas más afectadas
articles.standfirst: Las borrascas Charles y Bruna no serán el final del episodio de inestabilidad
articles.summary: Las borrascas Charles y Bruna no serán el final del episodio de inestabilidad
articles.body: Prácticamente toda España ha notado estos días los efectos del choque de las borrascas Bruna y Charles. Las precipitaciones han sido generalizadas y el viento ha soplado con fuerza en varios puntos del territorio, incluso más allá de los 100 kilómetros por hora. Según las previsiones, durante el fin de semana seguirá esta situación y podría alargarse a la próxima semana. El paso de Charles, según Meteored, será rápido y provocará que este jueves, 12 de noviembre, sea algo más tranquilo. Pero a partir del viernes, esto volverá a cambiar, y es que los expertos apuntan a una especie de pasillo entre las dos borrascas que podría traer más frentes a la Península procedentes de un borrasca sobre Islandia. Todo indica que será el noroeste peninsular la zona más afectada por esta situación, provocando lluvias más abundantes y persistentes. Existe la posibilidad, además, de que esto se acabe extendiendo a otros puntos de la geografía española, como por ejemplo al resto del norte y el centro del país. Por su parte, el viento continuará soplando con fuerza, aunque no se espera que traiga temperaturas demasiado bajas. Más bien, las previsiones apuntan a que podría haber valores muy suaves para esta época y no hay indicios de que se vaya a producir alguna helada importante en zonas de montaña. La Agencia Estatal de Meteorología (AEMET) ha publicado los avisos para este jueves y ha señalado que el nivel máximo de alerta será naranja, siendo estos por rachas de viento de unos 100 km/h en Almería, Albacete y Murcia. Además, habrá que tener cuidado con los fenómenos costeros en las islas Baleares, donde el peligro será importante. Las alertas por lluvia, de carácter más leve, quedarán acotadas a Asturias, Cantabria, Cataluña y Galicia.

articles.title: Lensman Hirak Sen, chronicler of Satyajit Ray’s later years and Oscar moment, dies
articles.summary: KOLKATA: Still photographer Hirak Sen, whose camera quietly chronicled the working life of Satyajit Ray through the master’s final decade, died on
articles.body: KOLKATA: Still photographer Hirak Sen, whose camera quietly chronicled the working life of Satyajit Ray through the master’s final decade, died on Wednesday. He was 71. Sen had been suffering from dementia and heart ailments for some time.Sen’s association with the Ray household began casually, almost accidentally. He first visited the family in 1974 as a 19-year-old friend of Sandip Ray. Before long, the young visitor had become a familiar presence on sets and at the Ray home on Bishop Lefroy Road. Drawn to the atmosphere of filmmaking, he began clicking photographs alongside Ray’s celebrated on-set photographer Nemai Ghosh.What started as curiosity soon became commitment. Sen followed Ray’s unit for years, watching, waiting and learning the rhythms of a film set. Eventually, he was accepted as an official still photographer. From 1980 until Ray’s death in 1992, Sen remained a constant companion, documenting Ray at work—directing actors, writing, composing music, planning shots and sitting in moments of deep concentration between takes.Among Sen’s most historic images was the photograph of Ray receiving his honorary Oscar from his hospital bed on March 16, 1992. Ray’s acceptance speech, recorded on video that day, was broadcast live 14 days later during the 64th Academy Awards ceremony.“I remember him being with us on the sets of Sonar Kella,” Sandip Ray recalled. “He had a great eye and captured candid moments. His photograph of Baba laughing is particularly endearing to me.”Sen was not merely an observer with a camera. Over the years, he became part of the extended Ray circle, sharing an easy camaraderie with Nemai Ghosh and earning the affection of the unit. Sandip remembered him as a lively presence away from the solemnity of work.“Others too loved having him at adda sessions. He was a livewire off the set and loved leg-pulling,” he said.In later years, Sen’s health declined sharply. Dementia took away much of his memory, though those who knew him remembered vividly the young man who had once wandered into the Ray household and stayed on to preserve some of its most intimate moments.“In the final years, he was afflicted with dementia and the loss of memory was rapid,” Sandip said. “When I heard the news of his demise, scenes and images of him in this house flashed back. articles.title: Kacey Musgraves remembers Dolly Parton: Reveals that one habit she broke for the country music icon
articles.summary: Kacey Musgraves reminisces about her encounters with the late Dolly Parton, sharing how the country music icon inspired her to break her habit of being late and the collective grief felt after her passing.
articles.body: Kacey Musgraves recently looked back on her memories of country music legend Dolly Parton, recalling the warmth, humour and humility that made the singer so beloved. Although the two crossed paths several times at award shows and industry events, Musgraves admits that meeting someone she admired so much never stopped feeling special.According to People, Musgraves reflected on her encounters with Parton and revealed that the legendary singer even inspired her to break one of her habits: being late. The Grammy-winning artist also spoke about the collective sadness following Parton's passing in August 2026.Kacey Musgraves recalls meeting Dolly PartonMusgraves, 38, said, “I was lucky to get to be around her several times, and each time I was just like, ‘What do I say?’ Looking back, she described those meetings as memorable experiences that left a lasting impression.The two singers also shared a musical connection. In 2019, Musgraves joined Katy Perry for a performance of Parton's hit 'Here You Come Again' at the MusiCares Person of the Year tribute, which celebrated Parton's contribution to music. Later, Musgraves and Perry joined Parton onstage during the Grammy Awards.“She was exactly like you would think that she would be — so humble, sense of humour, fun, so professional, really warm,” Musgraves said before adding, “You could see someone like that and understand how they could be closed off and jaded, but she was anything but that.”The one habit Kacey Musgraves broke for Dolly PartonOne of the lighter memories Musgraves shared involved her reputation for running late. The singer has previously joked about her poor punctuality through the lyrics of her 2018 song 'Slow Burn', in which she describes herself as someone who is always in a hurry and rarely early.However, meeting Parton was apparently enough to change that routine. Musgraves recalled making a special effort to arrive on time whenever she had an engagement involving the country legend.“I think the only time I’ve probably ever been really, really on time in my life was doing something with Dolly. I was like, ‘I’m not being late for that!’” quipped Musgraves.Kacey Musgraves reflects on the loss of Dolly PartonDolly Parton passed away at 80. Her family announced on August 25, 2026, that she passed away in Nashville following a short battle with cancer.Musgraves later mourned her loss on social media. She also paid tribute through music, performing Parton's songs, including 'Here You Come Again' and '9 to 5', during her 'Middle of Nowhere' tour. At the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards, she honoured the late singer with a performance of 'I Will Always Love You' during the in memoriam segment.“I think losing Dolly was collective grief. And it really, I think, showed us how starved we are for a really true matriarch in that sense. She’s been with us for so long. She’s almost like Mr. Rogers, but times a billion in a way — Mr. Rogers wearing rhinestones. It was amazing to see how beloved she was and, I think, probably the closest thing we have to American royalty, you know what I mean?” Musgraves said.Musgraves also described Parton as one of the closest figures to American royalty because of the affection people across different backgrounds felt for her.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Bill Cosby accused of allegedly failing to pay $59M sexual assault damages: court docs
articles.summary: Bill Cosby allegedly ignored a court order to disclose his assets under oath, and lawyers say a California judge could issue a warrant to bring him in.
articles.body: A woman who accused Bill Cosby of sexual assault in 1972 was awarded $59 million earlier this year after a jury found the disgraced comedian liable for his actions. The woman, Donna Motsinger, claimed in new court documents obtained by Fox News Digital that Cosby allegedly "has not paid a single dollar" of awarded damages, and asked a judge to hold the fallen television star in contempt of court after violating an October order. Joshua Wurtzel, partner at Schlam Stone & Dolan LLP, explained that there's a "real possibility" the court issues a warrant for Cosby's arrest, but not for failing to pay the judgment. BILL COSBY FOUND LIABLE FOR 1972 SEXUAL ASSAULT, JURY AWARDS $59.25M TO ACCUSER "Courts typically are not able to jail people for unpaid civil debts," Wurtzel told Fox News Digital. "The warrant would be for ignoring the court’s October order requiring him to answer written questions about his assets under oath. "If the court issues an order to show cause, Cosby is personally served, and he does not appear, California law lets the judge issue a warrant directing the sheriff to bring him in. And if the court holds him in contempt, it can order him confined until he answers the questions." Wurtzel noted that being held in contempt is "both a serious threat and a tactic to force compliance." "If the court issues an order to show cause, Cosby is personally served, and he does not appear, California law lets the judge issue a warrant directing the sheriff to bring him in." "But if Cosby is located outside of California, it may be very difficult to actually execute on the arrest warrant and will depend on whether law enforcement in California is willing to have him extradited from another state," Wurtzel said. RAVEN-SYMONE DEFENDS BILL COSBY'S LEGACY DESPITE ‘HORRIFIC’ SEXUAL ASSAULT ACCUSATIONS FROM MULTIPLE WOMEN Los Angeles criminal defense lawyer Danny Rubin told Fox News Digital that Motsinger's request for a "debtor's examination" could benefit her case against Cosby. "Someone who was awarded money in a civil judgment is able to conduct what's called a 'debtor's exam' where the judgment debtor, the person who owes the money, must provide information as to the amount of his total assets and where they are located," Rubin said. "Failure to appear for this exam can result in an arrest warrant. This is a serious legal tactic to force someone to sit for a debtor's exam. Arrest warrants are usually granted in cases where the debtor has repeatedly failed to appear." She was also awarded $40 million in punitive damages. In October, Judge Bradley S. Phillips granted Motsinger's request for a hearing on a motion to compel, and also ordered Cosby to "serve verified, code-compliant responses, without objection, within ten (10) days of this Order." Additionally, the judge ordered that Cosby "shall pay monetary sanctions of $1560 to Plaintiff's counsel within ten (10) days of this Order." articles.title: Shah Rukh Khan's Rs 300 crore Mannat has cyrotherapy, cinema hall, the actor started from scratch and now teaches his children to be dignified, humble and hardworking despite their privilege
articles.summary: Shah Rukh Khan recently attended the launch of high-end penthouses in Dubai named after him and designed by his wife Gauri Khan.
articles.body: Shah Rukh Khan recently attended the launch of high-end penthouses in Dubai named after him and designed by his wife Gauri Khan. The event was attended by the couple and filmmaker Karan Johar, who hosted the evening. During the launch, the three revisited Shah Rukh's journey from struggling to own a home to becoming the owner of Mannat, one of Mumbai's most recognisable celebrity residences. They also spoke about Gauri's contribution to his journey and the role she has played in building their life together.During the event, Karan offered a glimpse into the luxurious amenities at Mannat, revealing some of the features that make the superstar's residence special. “Shah Rukh Khan’s Mannat has a cinema hall, cryotherapy, and sea view,” he said. He also suggested that several elements of the Dubai development had been inspired by features of Shah Rukh's own home.Karan went on to acknowledge Gauri's contribution to everything Shah Rukh has achieved, describing her as the pillar behind the actor and his family. He said, “I want everyone to know that there would be no Mannat, there would be no Khan family if it wasn’t for this pillar standing right next to me.” He further compared her to Lakshmi, the Hindu goddess of wealth and prosperity, saying, “Whosoever’s life she has touched, that life turns into gold.”Shah Rukh, too, spoke about Gauri being his constant source of encouragement and motivation. Recalling their early years together and the milestones they achieved as a couple, he said, “Our first home, our first car, our first journey together, but Gauri always said, ‘These are just a beginning.’ The first of many. And what we do next will be King style.”Speaking about what having a home means to him, Shah Rukh described it as much more than a physical space. He said that a home gives people a sense of belonging and becomes an important part of their identity.“I have always been a big believer of home. A place to live in. Home is where you start from. And home is the nicest word in the universe. The word home turns into an emotion. It becomes your identity, your pride and sometimes even becomes your life,” he said.The actor also expressed gratitude to the developers for naming their latest luxury project after him, explaining why the gesture was particularly meaningful given his own journey. Recalling his childhood and the loss of his parents at an early age, Shah Rukh spoke about his longstanding desire to have a home of his own.“I am somebody who came from a background, my parents died early,” he said, before adding, “It is not a sob story. This is how it was. I never had a house. My biggest yearning in life — of course, I love my films, family, work — but the only thing I love more than anything else is to have a house.”Shah Rukh also shared a light-hearted anecdote about his children, who often tease him about his enthusiasm for buying homes in different cities. Recalling their response whenever he talks about owning another property, he said, “They say, ‘Papa, hum har jagah pe ghar thodi le sakte hai (We can’t buy a house everywhere).’ But I have been fortunate, God has been kind.”The superstar revealed that he did not have a home of his own until he married Gauri, with the two purchasing their first house together. He also recalled that both their first home and Mannat were beyond what they could comfortably afford at the time of purchase. However, he believes that having faith in one's dreams can make even seemingly impossible aspirations come true.Explaining why owning a home holds such emotional significance for him, Shah Rukh said that it is the one place where people can return, reflect and find the strength to face life's challenges again.“For me, it is very important, which I often tell people, that in life there are good days, bad days, sad days and sometimes even depressing days. But when you finally come knocking, you have to come back to your own home because you regenerate there, you refigure things out and go back to face the harsh world again. So I am a big believer of house,” he said.He also had an encouraging message for people who dream of owning a home someday, urging them to believe in their aspirations. “Agar aap ghar ke liye mannat karenge, toh zindagi mein sabse khoobsurat ghar milega. Think big and believe big,” he said.Gauri, who was also present at the launch, spoke about her experience of designing their iconic Mumbai residence. Suggesting that the process was relatively smooth because she had complete creative freedom at home, she joked, “They have no option but to agree to all my designs,” drawing laughter from the audience.Shah Rukh also reflected on the appreciation he has received from audiences across generations and the values he hopes to instil in his children. He said that the love and recognition he has received throughout his career have taught him the importance of humility, dignity and hard work. He wants his children to understand that success comes from giving their best, regardless of the field they choose.“Jokes apart, people have known me for years. There are different generations of people here who have appreciated my work and I am extremely grateful and thankful to all of them all my life. And the one thing I have learnt from this kind of appreciation over the years is to teach my children good manners, dignity, and above all humility and the passion that they should give their best to whatever they do. Because if you give your best to whatever you do, there is no limit to what you can achieve, because the love of the people is always there if you work hard. So I just want them to be dignified, humble and hardworking,” he shared.Shah Rukh and Gauri Khan purchased their first home together in 1991 in Panchsheel Park, South Delhi. The actor initially owned the basement and the first floor of the property before eventually acquiring the remaining floors. The couple later bought a sea-facing apartment in Mumbai before moving into Mannat in 2001.Located in Bandra's Bandstand area, Mannat has since become one of Mumbai's most iconic celebrity addresses. The heritage property, which has been a landmark for fans visiting the city, is currently undergoing renovation, with Gauri reportedly overseeing plans to add extra floors to the residence. From their first home together to the sprawling sea-facing bungalow they now call their own, the couple's journey reflects the dreams and milestones Shah Rukh spoke about at the Dubai launch.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Angelina Jolie plans to leave Hollywood after Brad Pitt divorce battle; actress buys Connecticut estate after selling $24.75 million LA mansion as reason for East Coast move emerges
articles.summary: Angelina Jolie appears to be ready to leave Los Angeles behind and begin a new chapter on the East Coast.
articles.body: Angelina Jolie appears to be ready to leave Los Angeles behind and begin a new chapter on the East Coast. The 51-year-old Hollywood actress has reportedly purchased an estate in Connecticut, months after selling her historic Los Feliz mansion for $24.75 million. Her reported relocation comes after years of living in California following her separation from former husband Brad Pitt and her decision to raise their six children there.According to Page Six Hollywood, Jolie has bought a property in Connecticut, although the exact location of her new estate remains undisclosed. The development comes after the actress had repeatedly spoken about wanting to leave Los Angeles once her youngest children, twins Knox and Vivienne, turned 18.Interestingly, Jolie had previously revealed that her decision to remain in Los Angeles was closely connected to her divorce from Pitt and her desire to keep their children close to their father. With the twins turning 18 in July 2026, the actress now appears to be moving ahead with her long-discussed plans to relocate.Why Angelina Jolie wanted to leave Los Angeles after Brad Pitt splitJolie had spoken candidly about her plans to move away from Los Angeles during a 2024 interview with The Hollywood Reporter. The actress explained that she had grown up in the city but was staying there because of circumstances surrounding her divorce.“I grew up in this town. I am here because I have to be here from a divorce, but as soon as they're 18, I'll be able to leave,” she had said.She also explained that raising a large family meant prioritising privacy, peace and safety. Jolie felt that the sense of humanity she had experienced in different parts of the world was different from what she had grown up with in Los Angeles.Her decision to stay in California was also linked to keeping her children close to Pitt. In an earlier interview in 2021, she had revealed that one of the main reasons for purchasing her Los Feliz mansion was its proximity to the actor.“I wanted it to be close to their dad, who is only five minutes away,” she had said.Now that her youngest children have turned 18, Jolie appears to have more flexibility to move away from California.Angelina Jolie sells $24.75 million Los Angeles mansionJolie's reported Connecticut purchase comes nearly two months after she sold her sprawling Los Feliz mansion for $24.75 million in September 2026.The actress purchased the property for approximately $24.5 million in 2017, following her separation from Pitt. The historic 11,000-square-foot estate once belonged to legendary filmmaker Cecil B. DeMille.Built in 1913, the property sits on nearly two acres and features six bedrooms and 10 bathrooms. It offers sweeping views of the Hollywood Hills and the Griffith Observatory.Jolie initially listed the mansion for approximately $29.85 million in May before finding a buyer in September. The property features a farmhouse-style kitchen, multiple living spaces, a library, a tea house, a wine cellar and a fitness studio. Its outdoor amenities include expansive lawns, a swimming pool and a pool house.The sale marked an important step towards the next phase of her life, particularly after she had spoken about wanting to spend less time in Los Angeles.Angelina Jolie plans to spend more time in Cambodia and New YorkWhile Connecticut is reportedly her new residential destination, Jolie has also expressed her desire to spend considerable time outside Hollywood.In her 2024 interview, the actress said she wanted to spend a lot of time in Cambodia, where she owns a residence, and visit family members living in different parts of the world.She also owns a property in Manhattan. Her reported East Coast move could therefore bring her closer to some of her existing professional commitments while allowing her to pursue international projects.Earlier, a source told TMZ that Jolie was looking forward to a more global lifestyle after selling her Los Angeles home, including spending time in Cambodia and focusing on international work.Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt's bitter divorce and strained relationship with childrenJolie's reported relocation brings attention back to her complicated relationship with Pitt. A source previously told the Daily Mail that the actor finds the situation deeply painful and believes Jolie's role in the breakdown of his relationship with the children amounts to a betrayal. These claims have been attributed to sources and have not been independently established.The 2016 plane incident involved allegations of abuse, which Pitt has consistently denied. articles.title: Mass cleanliness drive in Nagaland on Nov 13 ahead of festive season
articles.summary: Nagaland to hold statewide mass cleanliness drive on Nov 13 from 6am ahead of festivals and Hornbill Festival; shops closed till noon, non-compliance to face action.
articles.body: Dimapur: The Nagaland govt will conduct a statewide mass social work from 6 am on Friday to clean and beautify public places and surrounding areas ahead of the festive season and the Hornbill Festival.The drive will include the removal of road encroachments, exposed construction materials and unhygienic structures, including poorly maintained toilets and urinals, pigsties and illegal constructions.The govt said non-compliance would invite forcible removal without further notice. The cost of clearance would be recovered from the defaulting parties.Govt employees, urban local bodies, village councils, civil society organisations, local associations and members of the public will participate in the drive.Departments and agencies assigned to designated locations will arrange manpower and disposal trucks for clearing and disposing of collected waste, ensuring proper cleaning of their respective areas and completion of unfinished work the following day.Municipal and town councils, through their respective councillors, will supervise the programme in urban areas, while village councils will coordinate the social work in rural areas with local administrative officers.All shops and business establishments across the state will remain closed till 12 noon on Friday to facilitate the social work.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Guwahati | Silver Rate in Guwahati | Bank Holidays in Guwahati | Public Holidays in Guwahati | Guwahati AQI | Weather in Guwahati | Petrol Price in Guwahati | Diesel Price in Guwahati | CNG Price in Guwahati | LPG Price in GuwahatiStay updated with the latest Guwahati news. articles.standfirst: El dúo musical ha asegurado que “después de discutir” hay que acabar el mal rollo
articles.summary: El dúo musical ha asegurado que “después de discutir” hay que acabar el mal rollo
articles.body: El dúo musical Estopa ha sido galardonado con el Premio 20minutos 2026 durante una gala celebrada este jueves, 12 de noviembre, en el Teatro Real de Madrid. Los hermanos David y José Muñoz han recibido este reconocimiento por sus 27 años de trayectoria y su contribución a la música y la cultura popular española. El citado medio ha destacado la cercanía del grupo con varias generaciones de oyentes y su capacidad para reflejar inquietudes sociales en sus canciones. Además, el premio coincide con un año especial para la banda, marcado por la publicación de ‘La Maketa’, un trabajo que recupera los primeros temas que compusieron antes de saltar a la fama. “Gracias a todos los presentes por asistir. Nos ponemos muy nerviosos al hablar. Como todos los premios, se lo dedicamos a nuestros padres, parejas, hijos y colegas. Nuestros padres están muy contentos por nosotros profesionalmente hablando, pero sobre todo de que mi hermano y yo nos sigamos cuidando, no todos los hermanos son como los Gallagher, eso debería ser una anomalía”, comenzaba diciendo David con humor. Tras estas primeras palabras, y aprovechando que faltan escasas horas para que arranque la campaña electoral con motivo de las elecciones del 29N, el dúo ha querido hacer una importante reflexión sobre nuestro país. De esta manera, ambos cantantes han apuntado que es importante la convivencia y que haya respeto, independiente de la ideología. "En el bar de mis padres se reunía todo tipo de gente, gente del Madrid, del Barça, extremeños, de Bilbao, del PP, del PSOE... Nosotros éramos niños de 10 o 12 años, y aprendimos que, después de discutir en un debate de altura, se tomaban un botellín y se acababa el mal rollo. Y eso es lo que nos gustaría que fuera España en un futuro. Que haya respeto", han sentenciado.

articles.title: European Union Film Festival begins at St Edmund’s College
articles.summary: 31st EU Film Festival 2026 opens at St Edmund’s College, Shillong with Asian Confluence; runs till Nov 18, promoting cinema appreciation and cultural exchange.
articles.body: Shillong: The Shillong edition of the 31st European Union Film Festival (EUFF) 2026 began at the St Edmund’s College auditorium on Thursday.
